lm_output:
The text that was shown before this instruction is about two separate topics:

1. The Lego Movie and related media, specifically focusing on Superman (voiced by Channing Tatum) as a Master Builder, his role in the story, and his relationship with other characters.

2. An aircraft incident, with details about the cabin pressure dropping, cabin altitude warning, master caution activation and deactivation, and changes in the autopilot selected altitude.

Here is the text reproduced for clarity:

The Lego Movie related information:
- A group of Lego minifigures that can build things without instructions, known as Master Builders, meet in the "Dog" part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues.
- Superman, a DC Comics superhero and member of the Justice League, is one of the Master Builders.
- In The Lego Movie, Superman is shown to be annoyed by Green Lantern and was among the Master Builders that attend the meeting in Cloud Cuckoo Land.
- During the attack on Cloud Cuckoo Land, Superman took down one of the Super Secret Police's vehicles before being immobilized by a wad of gum leading to his capture.
- In The Lego Batman Movie, he and Batman have a hostile relationship similar to how they started out in Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice.

Aircraft incident information:
- The cabin pressure drops from 14.09 to 11.64 psi (97.1 to 80.3 kPa) at an altitude greater than 10,000 feet (3,048 m) above sea level, activating a "cabin altitude >10,000 feet warning".
- Pressurization or supplemental oxygen becomes necessary above that altitude.
- At 5:12:34 PM, a master caution activates as the cabin pressure continues to drop, recorded at 9.08 psi (62.6 kPa).
- The master caution deactivates at 5:12:52 PM.
- The aircraft reaches a maximum altitude of 16,320 feet (4,974 m) at 5:13:41 PM and begins to descend
